notes: ## [2.0.1] - 2026-10-11  ### Added - **One-click Pengu setup**: Opening the app for the first time now downloads Pengu Loader, installs both bundled plugins, and starts it, with no manual step. Later launches only start Pengu; an existing installation is reused and never re-downloaded. On the very first run Windows shows its usual UAC confirmation.  ### Changed - **Dependency updates**: Tauri 2.12, React 19.3, Vite 8.3, rustls 0.23.43, `dirs` 6.0, and the npm and Cargo minor/patch groups. The 2.0.0 installers were built before these landed.  ### Fixed - Removed the unused SonarCloud integration, its workflow, and the related repository secret.  ### Tests - 202 frontend and plugin tests, 1 Rust test, and a website media check pass.
